body.en: The IB offers two SL mathematics courses: Analysis and Approaches (AA SL) emphasises mathematical rigour, proof, and algebraic/calculus thinking. Applications and Interpretation (AI SL) emphasises modelling, technology (GDC required), statistics, and real-world problem-solving.

label.en: ⚠ IB Mathematics SL Exam Traps & Command Terms

body.en:
3 Significant Figures Rule: All non-exact numerical values must be written to exactly 3 significant figures unless explicitly stated otherwise. Premature rounding during intermediate steps forfeits the final accuracy mark (A1).

Command Terms: 'Show that' means the answer is already given on the question paper; you must present fully justified algebraic working with no skipped steps. 'Hence' means you must use the result of the preceding part; failing to do so earns zero method marks.

Paper 1 vs Paper 2: Paper 1 prohibits any calculator; leave answers as simplified fractions, surds, \(e\), and \(\pi\). Paper 2 requires GDC proficiency (graphing window selection, intersection solving, \(\text{binompdf}\), and \(\text{normcdf}\)).

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — IB Method Marks [M1] Protect Reasoning Across Multi-Part Chains
label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه الطريقة رياضياً — كيف تحمي درجات الطريقة [M1] التسلسل الرياضي في البكالوريا الدولية

body.en: Follow-Through & Method Scoring: On IB Papers 1, 2, and 3, writing explicit algebraic or GDC setup equations earns [M1] method credit even before numerical evaluation, and subsequent parts link via "Hence" (must use the preceding result) versus "Hence or otherwise" (any valid method accepted).
body.ar: منهجية التصحيح في البكالوريا الدولية: كتابة خطوات الإعداد الرياضي بوضوح تمنح درجات الطريقة [M1]، مع التمييز الدقيق بين صيغة Hence (إلزامية استخدام النتيجة السابقة) وHence or otherwise.

problem.en: Solve \( e^{2x} = 7 \) (a) giving the exact value, and (b) correct to 3 significant figures.
problem.ar: حل المعادلة \( e^{2x} = 7 \): (أ) بالقيمة الدقيقة، و(ب) مقرباً إلى ٣ أرقام معنوية.

solution.ar: (أ) \( x = \frac{1}{2}\ln 7 \). (ب) بالتقريب إلى ٣ أرقام معنوية: \( x \approx 0.973 \).

problem.en: Find the values of \( k \) for which \( x^2 + kx + 9 = 0 \) has two equal real roots.
problem.ar: أوجد قيم \( k \) التي تجعل للمعادلة \( x^2 + kx + 9 = 0 \) جذرين حقيقيين متساويين.

solution.en: Equal real roots require \( \Delta = b^2 - 4ac = 0 \) [M1]: \( k^2 - 36 = 0 \implies k = \pm 6 \) [A2].

problem.en: \( \$5{,}000 \) is invested at \( 4.8\% \) nominal annual interest compounded monthly for \( 5 \) years. Calculate the future value to 2 decimal places.
problem.ar: استُثمر مبلغ \( \$5{,}000 \) بمعدل فائدة اسمي \( 4.8\% \) سنوياً يركّب شهرياً لمدة \( 5 \) سنوات. احسب القيمة المستقبلية لأقرب منزلتين عشريتين.

solution.en: Using \( FV = PV\left(1 + \frac{r}{100k}\right)^{kn} \) with \( k = 12, n = 5 \): \[ FV = 5000(1.004)^{60} \approx \$6{,}353.21 \] [M1][A1].

rows.ar: Solving \(-3x > 12\) as \(x > -4\) (نظرة عامة على رياضيات البكالوريا الدولية للمستوى القياسي (IB SL))

rows.en: Dividing by a negative number reverses order on the real number line.
Flip the inequality symbol whenever multiplying or dividing by a negative: \(x < -4\).
Computing round-trip average speed as \(\frac{v_1 + v_2}{2}\)
Time spent at the slower speed is longer than time spent at the faster speed.
Use total distance over total time: \(v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{2v_1 v_2}{v_1 + v_2}\).

body.en: High-Speed Exam Shortcut (IB Diploma Mathematics: Analysis & Approaches / Applications & Interpretation SL): When a linear system asks for a combined expression like \(3x + 3y\) rather than \(x\) and \(y\) individually, add or subtract the two equations directly before isolating either variable—this often yields the target expression in a single step.

question.en: An IB AA SL student scores 64/80 on Paper 1 (40%), 72/80 on Paper 2 (40%), and 16/20 on the Internal Assessment (20%). Calculate the student's overall weighted percentage.

hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(0.40(80) + 0.40(90) + 0.20(80) = 32 + 36 + 16\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

question.en:
[Practice 2 · Medium] Three air-quality monitoring stations are positioned at \(A(2, 2)\), \(B(8, 4)\), and \(C(4, 8)\), where coordinates are measured in kilometres.
(a) Find the coordinates of the midpoint \(M\) of segment \([AB]\) and the gradient of \([AB]\). [2]
(b) Hence find the equation of the perpendicular bisector of \([AB]\) in the form \(y = mx + c\). [3]
(c) A new school is built at \(P(4.5, 4.5)\). By calculating the distance from \(P\) to each station, determine which station's Voronoi cell contains \(P\). [2]

hints.en: IB Markscheme (7 marks — AI SL Paper 1): (a) Midpoint \(M = \left(\frac{2+8}{2}, \frac{2+4}{2}\right) = (5, 3)\) ; \(m_{AB} = \frac{4 - 2}{8 - 2}\).

hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(m_\perp = -\frac{1}{m_{AB}} = -3.00\) ، \(y - 3 = -3.00(x - 5) \implies y = -3.00x + 18.00\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

hints.en: (c) Distances: \(PA = 3.54\text{ km}, PB = 3.54\text{ km}, PC\) \(\implies\) closest to Station \(A\).
hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(PA = 3.54\text{ km}, PB = 3.54\text{ km}, PC\) ، \(\implies\) ، \(A\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

solution.en:
IB Markscheme (7 marks — AI SL Paper 1):
(a) Midpoint \(M = \left(\frac{2+8}{2}, \frac{2+4}{2}\right) = (5, 3)\) ; \(m_{AB} = \frac{4 - 2}{8 - 2} = 0.333\)
(b) Perpendicular gradient \(m_\perp = -\frac{1}{m_{AB}} = -3.00\)
Equation: \(y - 3 = -3.00(x - 5) \implies y = -3.00x + 18.00\)
(c) Distances: \(PA = 3.54\text{ km}, PB = 3.54\text{ km}, PC = 3.54\text{ km}\) \(\implies\) closest to Station \(A\)

question.en:
[Practice 3 · Medium] Three air-quality monitoring stations are positioned at \(A(1, 3)\), \(B(7, 1)\), and \(C(5, 7)\), where coordinates are measured in kilometres.
(a) Find the coordinates of the midpoint \(M\) of segment \([AB]\) and the gradient of \([AB]\). [2]
(b) Hence find the equation of the perpendicular bisector of \([AB]\) in the form \(y = mx + c\). [3]
(c) A new school is built at \(P(4, 4)\). By calculating the distance from \(P\) to each station, determine which station's Voronoi cell contains \(P\). [2]
(d) Explain what the Voronoi vertex \(V\) represents in the context of air-quality monitoring and describe how the toxic waste dump problem uses \(V\). [6]

hints.en: IB Markscheme (13 marks — AI SL Paper 2): (a) Midpoint \(M = \left(\frac{1+7}{2}, \frac{3+1}{2}\right) = (4, 2)\) ; \(m_{AB} = \frac{1 - 3}{7 - 1}\).

(b) Perpendicular gradient \(m_\perp = -\frac{1}{m_{AB}} = 3.00\) Equation: \(y - 2 = 3.00(x - 4) \implies y = 3.00x - 10.00\) (c) Distances: \(PA = 3.16\text{ km}, PB = 4.24\text{ km}, PC = 3.16\text{ km}\) \(\implies\) closest to Station \(A\).
hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(m_\perp = -\frac{1}{m_{AB}} = 3.00\) ، \(y - 2 = 3.00(x - 4) \implies y = 3.00x - 10.00\) ، \(PA = 3.16\text{ km}, PB = 4.24\text{ km}, PC = 3.16\text{ km}\) ، \(\implies\) ، \(A\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

hints.en: (d) The Voronoi vertex \(V\) is equidistant from all three stations \(A, B, C\) , forming the centre of the largest empty circle ; in the toxic waste dump problem, \(V\) maximizes the minimum distance to any existing station .
hints.ar: تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(V\) ، \(A, B, C\) ، \(V\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

solution.en:
IB Markscheme (13 marks — AI SL Paper 2):
(a) Midpoint \(M = \left(\frac{1+7}{2}, \frac{3+1}{2}\right) = (4, 2)\) ; \(m_{AB} = \frac{1 - 3}{7 - 1} = -0.333\)
(b) Perpendicular gradient \(m_\perp = -\frac{1}{m_{AB}} = 3.00\)
Equation: \(y - 2 = 3.00(x - 4) \implies y = 3.00x - 10.00\)
(c) Distances: \(PA = 3.16\text{ km}, PB = 4.24\text{ km}, PC = 3.16\text{ km}\) \(\implies\) closest to Station \(A\)
(d) The Voronoi vertex \(V\) is equidistant from all three stations \(A, B, C\) , forming the centre of the largest empty circle ; in the toxic waste dump problem, \(V\) maximizes the minimum distance to any existing station .

question.en:
[Practice 4 · Medium] A coastguard vessel leaves Port \(A\) and travels \(11\text{ km}\) on a true bearing of \(045^\circ\) to Waypoint \(B\). It then changes course and travels \(15\text{ km}\) on a bearing of \(145^\circ\) to Rescue Point \(C\).
(a) Show that \(\angle ABC = 80^\circ\). [2]
(b) Find the direct distance \(AC\) in \(\text{km}\), giving your answer to 3 significant figures. [3]
(c) Find the area of the sea region enclosed by triangle \(ABC\). [2]

hints.en: IB Markscheme (7 marks — AA/AI SL Paper 2, Section A): (a) Using alternate/co-interior angles with the North line at \(B\): \(\angle ABC = (180^\circ - 145^\circ) + 45^\circ\) [AG]

solution.en:
IB Markscheme (7 marks — AA/AI SL Paper 2, Section A):
(a) Using alternate/co-interior angles with the North line at \(B\): \(\angle ABC = (180^\circ - 145^\circ) + 45^\circ = 80^\circ\) [AG]
(b) By the Cosine Rule: \(AC^2 = 11^2 + 15^2 - 2(11)(15)\cos(80^\circ)\)
\(AC = \sqrt{288.70} = 17.0\text{ km}\) (3 s.f.)
(c) Area \(= \frac{1}{2}(11)(15)\sin(80^\circ)\) \(= 81.2\text{ km}^2\) (3 s.f.)

question.en: Consider the function \( f(x) = 2x + 5 \). What is the value of \( f(3) \)?

hints.en: To find \( f(3) \), substitute \( x=3 \) into the function \( f(x) = 2x + 5 \).
hints.ar: To أوجد \(f(3)\), عوّض \(x=3\) into the function \(f(x) = 2x + 5\).

hints.en: Set up the formula/expression: \(f(3) = 2(3) + 5\). Substitute and simplify: \(f(3) = 6 + 5\).
hints.ar: جهّز الصيغة أو العبارة الرياضية: \(f(3) = 2(3) + 5\). عوّض بالقيم وبسّط العبارة: \(f(3) = 6 + 5\).

solution.en: To find \( f(3) \), substitute \( x=3 \) into the function \( f(x) = 2x + 5 \). \( f(3) = 2(3) + 5 = 6 + 5 = 11 \). [M1] [A1]
solution.ar: To أوجد \(f(3)\), عوّض \(x=3\) into the function \(f(x) = 2x + 5\). \(f(3) = 2(3) + 5 = 6 + 5 = 11\). [M1] [A1]
